chunks: And Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:

I asked Abu Ibrahim عليه السلام about one performing tamattuʿ: if he is an elderly old man, or a woman who fears menstruation, may he hasten the tawaf for hajj before going to Mina? He said: “Yes, one who is like this may hasten it.”
He said: And I asked him about a man who enters ihram for hajj from Mecca, then sees the House empty and so performs tawaf around it before going out— is there anything upon him? He said: “No.”

key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, the ritual destination during hajj
key_terms.ٱلطَّوَافَ: the tawaf, circumambulation of the Kaʿbah

ai.seo_question: Can an elderly pilgrim or a woman fearing menstruation perform the tawaf of hajj before going to Mina?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning advancing the tawaf of hajj in specific circumstances during tamattuʿ. It permits elderly persons and women fearing menstruation to perform the tawaf earlier before going to Mina, while also stating that if a man in ihram for hajj from Mecca performs tawaf before departing, there is no penalty upon him.
